ios.desc:
Manage your apps on the go with the App Store Connect app for iPhone and iPad.

• View the status of your apps and manage App Store submissions.
• Manage tester groups, add new builds and testers, view screenshot and crash feedback.
• View key sales and trends information to monitor app performance.
• View and respond to your latest customer ratings and reviews.
• Generate marketing assets to promote your apps’ biggest moments, such as getting featured in select placements on the App Store, or when you’re submitting a new app launch or new version.
• Receive notifications about key events, such as app status changes, new customer reviews, tester feedback, and featuring in select placements on the App Store.

quotes.text: I’m not sure about macOS, but on iOS you can install the App Store Connect app (https://apps.apple.com/app/id1234793120) and then enable notifications for new reviews from there. ([app] → Notifications → Mobile → Reviews, [your initials] → Notifications → Customer Reviews)
